query: SELECT avg(COALESCE(temperature, 0)) AS value FROM weather WHERE location = $1 AND date > COALESCE($2::date, '-infinity') AND date <= COALESCE($3::date, 'infinity')
SELECT max(COALESCE(temperature, 0)) AS value FROM weather WHERE location = $1 AND date > COALESCE($2::date, '-infinity') AND date <= COALESCE($3::date, 'infinity')
SELECT min(COALESCE(temperature, 0)) AS value FROM weather WHERE location = $1 AND date > COALESCE($2::date, '-infinity') AND date <= COALESCE($3::date, 'infinity')

SELECT location, date, COALESCE(temperature, 0) AS temperature, COALESCE(humidity, 0) AS humidity FROM weather WHERE location = $1 AND date > COALESCE($2::date, '-infinity') AND date <= COALESCE($3::date, 'infinity') ORDER BY date LIMIT $4::int
